items.title: Timberborn 1.1 Update: Succulents Just Got a Massive Buff
items.description: Timberborn's latest 1.1 Experimental update is here, and it's a big one for anyone struggling with water logistics. Succulents just got a 50% water yield buff, domed gardens and dance pits now act more like you'd think, and there are two brand-new maps to build on. Plus a new tubeway type that could change how you plan your transit and dam network entirely. In this video, I break down everything in the newest Timberborn 1.1 experimental: - Succulents get buffed: 50% more water yield, making them a legitimate emergency water source - Mechanical pump & well-being fixes: less guesswork, more intuitive behavior - Two new maps added to the Experimental branch - The new Impermeable tubeway and what it unlocks for your transport systems - Other balance changes worth knowing before you start a new save If you're playing on the Experimental branch or deciding whether it is now worth it to jump in, this covers exactly what changed and why it matters for your colony. If this helped, a like goes a long way And subscribe for ongoing Timberborn 1.1 coverage as updates keep rolling out. ~ Patch Notes https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1062090/view/702150052386177895?l=english https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1062090/view/681881498796689183?l=english ~ Socials Discord - https://discord.gg/4zMGpQNUnv ~ Chapters Intro - 0:00 New Additions - 0:25 Balance Updates - 1:05 Outro - 1:52
